text: tests.yml fires on a push to `main` or `candidate/**`, with no `tags:` trigger, and runs its macOS jobs and the rust job's macOS leg only on a `candidate/` push or a dispatch: after the sweep a read-only `bin/devbin release check` passes in Utilz, its checker finding that the test matrix fires on `candidate/`, and CI at the sweep's push is green on every job the run starts.
